2\. Edited lists can reuse or reverse ids 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
_valid accepts nonpositive IDs and a next_id that is no greater than an existing item's ID. If a
list has been hand-edited or merged into that state, _cmd_add uses the inconsistent value
directly, producing duplicate or negative IDs.
